comment: Castle grounds (roadmap F18, R1): ALttP area 0x1B as it is, in screens with open edges. The castle's axis (x 512) would fall on the seam of two 256 px screens, with the castle door, the gate and the bridge on it, so the middle is two 2x2 rooms (like the Village's) and the sides are 1x1 screens. Link comes in by the dirt road at the south edge, a key opens the portcullis of the outer wall, and he leaves by the castle door at the top of the courtyard stairs.
